hub.name: Kanav Bengani
hub.role: Software Engineer @ HubSpotSee the HubSpot card
hub.bio: I like building backend systems, tinkering with the buzzword that is AI, and occasionally making things people actually use — like BallboySee the Ballboy card.

hubspot.name: HubSpot
pts: Built agentic search to enhance discovery of 6,000+ published Marketplace integrations using MCP tools and skills.

Implemented a self-serve platform serving 80K+ users/week allowing marketing teams to update site content with no engineering support; designed SQL-backed database models, low-latency RPCs, and React UI components.
Resolved customer queries, high-severity incidents, and technical alerts (up to 40/week) on a 24/7 on-call rotation.

capitalone.name: Capital One
pts: Assessed image quality for over 100K documents/day — government-issued IDs, W-2s, and bank statements.
Extracted image data with 85% accuracy using OCR and surfaced it on a web app created using Flask and React.

ballboy.name: Ballboy
ballboy.stack: React Native · Django · Redis · Supabase · Cloudflare
pts: Founded a platform launched on iOS with 1.5K+ impressions where users join fantasy leagues following live tennis.
Led engineering using tools like Django, Redis, React Native, and Cloudflare to ensure a low-latency, real-time app.
Achieved 100K+ interactions while building a social media following across platforms — Instagram and TikTok.

reddit.name: Reddit Sentiment Analysis
pts: Fine-tuned an LLM that constructs sentiment from the respective subreddit, given a natural language query.
Parsed and filtered context using RAG and a BERT classifier; derived sentiment using the Meta Llama 3.1 8B model.

invariance.name: Invariance
pts: Architected an SDK that allows live UI restyling and restricted backend updates with a plain-English request per user.
Looped LLM generation against an automated verifier and LLM-as-a-judge until they clear developer-set invariants.
Devised a developer console to track website modification analytics, conflict resolutions, and end-user versioning.

factevo.name: FactEvo Optimization
pts: Utilized natural-based evolutionary computing to solve a university course scheduling optimization problem.
Ran 100K generations for natural selection to result in a pareto-optimal, i.e. non-dominated set of solutions.

shriners.name: Shriners Children's
pts: Improved surgical outcomes for cerebral palsy patients by developing an index with a predictive autoencoder model.
Published in the Journal of Biomechanics and presented posters at the GCMAS and ORS conferences.
shriners.cite: Wang SJ, Tabashum T, Kruger KM, et al., Bengani K, Albert MV. “Creating an autoencoder single summary metric to assess gait quality to compare surgical outcomes in children with cerebral palsy: The Shriners Gait Index (SGI).” Journal of Biomechanics 168:112092, May 2024.
